high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Google search result page on a mobile device. The search query entered is "Lakdi Ka Jhula," which translates to "Wooden Swing" in English. The main focus of the image is a wooden swing, commonly known as a "lakdi ka jhula," which is a traditional Indian swing made from wood. Main Object (Wooden Swing): The swing is made of polished wood, giving it a warm and rustic appearance. It has a long, horizontal seat with a backrest, designed for comfort and support.
